title: Instant Blockchain Domain Search
tagline: Search domain availability across various blockchain name providers
description: This is a simple tool that search domain availability across various blockchain name providers like ENS, Unstoppable Domains. The service also searched for domain availability on some norma TLDs like .com, .xyz, .io. It also connect with OpenSea to check if there taken domains are available for sale.
how_its_made:
This is mainly powered by TheGraph protocol.

ENS : Using custom subgraph

Unstoppable Domains : Using custom subgraph

Near (account name): Using Near RPC

.com, .io and .xyz domains : A custom NodeJS API powered by dns lookup

Twitter username - Using Twitter API

Listing status via OpenSea API
